name: NärCon Sommar
notes: Dates and venue published on en.narcon.se (opens 22 Jul 10:00, closes 25 Jul 10:00). Hosts Nordic Cosplay Championship; 2026 first prize was a week trip for two to Japan, not a published cash purse. badgePriceUsd converts the 2026 day ticket of 299 SEK (Kippu/Visit Linköping); 2027 tickets not on sale. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate for a mid-range Linköping room. Also confirmed: NärCon Expo, Södertälje Stadsscen, 21–22 Nov 2026; NärCon Vinter, Linköping, 25–28 Feb 2027. FX: ECB 9 Oct 2026, USD/SEK 9.9656. Heat is a relative cosplay-draw score, not official.

name: Comic Con Stockholm Winter
notes: Official site and Visit Stockholm: 30 Oct–1 Nov 2026, Stockholmsmässan, Mässvägen 1, Älvsjö. Adult day tickets from 385 SEK on the Winter 2026 ticket page; converted at ECB USD/SEK 9.9656. No published cash cosplay purse found. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate for Stockholm during the fair. Comic Con Stockholm Summer is also confirmed: 8–9 May 2027 at Kistamässan. Lat/lng is the fairgrounds, not central Stockholm.

name: Desucon
notes: Organizer post 14 Jun 2026 and Instagram: summer Desucon Fri–Sun 18–20 Jun 2027 at Sibeliustalo, Lahti. Desucon Frostbite is also set for 22–24 Jan 2027 at the same hall. 18+ at recent editions (Desucon 2026 sold 2900 weekend tickets at 39 EUR). badgePriceUsd converts that 39 EUR weekend badge at ECB EUR/USD 1.1206; 2027 price not published, so this is an estimate. No published cash contest purse. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate. Coords from Sibeliustalo, Ankkurikatu 7.

name: DoKomi
notes: Official when-and-where page: 9–11 Jul 2027, Stockumer Kirchstrasse 61; coords published by the organizer. Saturday ticket from 1 Jan 2027 is 47 EUR (45 EUR if bought by 31 Dec 2026); 47×1.1206. Presale starts 1 Nov 2026 20:00. Cosplay Ball is 10 Jul 2027, separate 35 EUR ticket, 18+. No published cash contest purse found. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate for fair-week Düsseldorf. Overlaps Japan Expo Paris (8–11 Jul 2027). One exhibitor portal lists 8–10 Jul 2027; the public site says 9–11 Jul.

name: Japan Expo Paris
notes: Official FR homepage: 8–11 Jul 2027 at Parc des Expositions de Paris-Nord Villepinte (Villepinte, not central Paris). 2027 ticket prices not published. badgePriceUsd converts the 2026 Saturday standard tariff of 41 EUR at EUR/USD 1.1206 and is an estimate. European Cosplay Gathering is a World Cosplay Summit qualifier; no cash first prize found, so contestPrizeUsd is null. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate. Overlaps DoKomi.

name: MCM London Comic Con
notes: Official site and Wikipedia next-event line: 23–25 Oct 2026, ExCeL London, Royal Victoria Dock. Saturday general entry listed at £38 including fees; £38×1.3220 (ECB GBP/USD 9 Oct 2026). Weekend pass was £98 and sold out. May 2027 London dates are not on the official site (MCM Birmingham 2027 is 'dates coming soon'). No published cash cosplay purse found. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate for Docklands during the show. Coords match the Wikipedia ExCeL pin.

name: Lucca Comics & Games
notes: Lucca Crea helpdesk and Turismo Lucca: Wed 28 Oct–Sun 1 Nov 2026, 09:00–19:00, across the historic centre (no single hall). 60th edition. badgePriceUsd converts the published online Saturday day price of 34.50 EUR including fees (Fantagiochi, 9 Oct 2026); Turismo Lucca also lists a €22–€30 range that may exclude fees. 2027 dates not announced. Cosplay is in Giardino degli Osservanti and other sites; no single published cash purse. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate; Lucca rooms spike during the festival. Lat/lng is the city centre, not one gate.

name: gamescom
notes: Official gamescom pages: 23–29 Aug 2027 at Koelnmesse. Public days 26–29 Aug; dev 23–24 Aug; Opening Night Live 24 Aug; business/media 25 Aug. Cosplay village has been in hall 5.1. 2027 ticket prices not out. badgePriceUsd converts the 2026 Saturday public day ticket of 41 EUR and is an estimate. contestPrizeUsd converts the 2026 Best Costume 1st prize of 3000 EUR (essence); 2027 purse not published, so treat as a carry-over estimate. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate for fair week.

name: Polymanga
notes: Organizers announced the return to Montreux for Easter, 26–29 Mar 2027, after 2024–2026 at Beaulieu Lausanne (20 minutes, 7 Apr 2026; Royal Plaza lists 2m2c, Avenue Claude Nobs 5). Some listings still say Lausanne. badgePriceUsd converts the FAQ day price of 35 CHF (4-day pass 55 CHF), which is the 2026 rate still on the site; 2027 price not separately posted, so estimate. CHF via ECB USD/CHF 0.83107. Food stands planned outdoors in Parc Vernex; halls are indoor. No published cash contest purse. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate.

name: CCON | Comic Con Stuttgart
notes: Official site: 28–29 Nov 2026, Messe Stuttgart, halls 4, 6, 8 and 10 plus atrium and foyer. 10th anniversary. Hours cited by guides as 09:00–18:00 both days. Face prices are not printed on the homepage (early bird until end of April only). badgePriceUsd is an estimate near third-party 'from about €15–17' / Nekodanshi '15+€', converted roughly at EUR/USD 1.1206; confirm in the ticket shop. No published cash cosplay purse. hotelPerNightUsd is an estimate. German Comic Con branding is this CCON Stuttgart event.
